Description: Shift+Enter sends the message instead of inserting a newline in the message composer.
Steps to reproduce:
1) Open message composer
2) Press Shift+Enter
3) Message is sent instead of newline inserted

Description: Muting a room doesn't fully suppress desktop notifications.
Steps to reproduce:
1) In a channel, open Room → Notifications → set Desktop: 'Nothing' (muted)
2) From another user, send a message in that channel
3) Desktop notification still appears

Description: Composer draft disappears when navigating between rooms quickly.
Steps to reproduce:
1) Type a long draft in #general
2) Switch to another room and back within 2s
3) Draft is gone

Description: Pasting an image attachment clears existing typed text.
Steps to reproduce:
1) Type a sentence in the composer
2) Paste an image from clipboard
3) Text disappears; only image remains

Description: Adding then removing a reaction leaves a stale count visible to other users.
Steps to reproduce:
1) React to a message
2) Remove the same reaction
3) Counter remains at 1 for other viewers until refresh

Description: Deleting the last reply in a thread keeps the thread count > 0.
Steps to reproduce:
1) Create thread with 1 reply
2) Delete the reply
3) Thread counter remains 1

Description: Forwarded thread messages display random strings instead of actual content.
Steps to reproduce:
1) Create a thread with messages
2) Forward a message from the thread to another channel
3) Quoted content shows random strings instead of actual text

Description: Shift+Enter sends message instead of new line when composing in threads.
Steps to reproduce:
1) Open a thread and start composing a message
2) Press Shift+Enter expecting a new line
3) Message gets sent instead
